rules: TDD: write the failing test(s) for a phase first, then implement until green.
npm run build and npm test must pass before committing each phase.
Stay inside the phase allowedFiles; do not touch out-of-scope paths.
Read the actual type/schema files before editing (CLAUDE.md pre-implementation audit).
Never use --no-verify; the pre-commit hook bumps the patch version.
Messaging is user-scoped, NOT household-scoped. Authorization is participant-based.
Storage is normalized rows; jsonb only for bounded fields; document shape built at the API boundary.
getDb() is never mocked; repository integration tests skip without DATABASE_URL.

decisions.discovery: household-member dropdown (reuse GET /api/household/members at client layer) + email-to-DM lookup (read-only, never creates a user)
decisions.realtime: polling; open thread every 3s via ?after=<messageId>; nav unread badge every 15s
decisions.attachments: images only, <=1MB, bytea in message_attachments table, served via guarded GET /api/messaging/attachments/:id
decisions.chatUi: @chatscope/chat-ui-kit-react + @chatscope/chat-ui-kit-styles, wrapped in local components, Tailwind/forest overrides
decisions.groupAdmin: creator is admin; only admin adds/removes others; any member may self-leave (set leftAt)
decisions.byteaNote: Drizzle pg-core has no native bytea; define customType<{ data: Buffer }>()

phases.name: Schema + repository
tests: createDirectConversation dedupes the same user pair
createGroupConversation sets creator as admin + participant rows
insertMessage bumps conversation.lastMessageAt
listMessagesAfter returns only newer messages ascending
listConversationsForUser sorted by lastMessageAt with correct unread, excludes left
getUnreadTotal counts only messages after lastReadAt from other senders
addParticipant / removeParticipant / selfLeave behave per rules
insertAttachment rejects >1MB and non-image MIME; getAttachment returns bytes
getUserByEmail returns user or null (read-only)
phases.commit: feat(messaging): schema + repository for conversations, messages, attachments

phases.name: Service layer + authorization guards
tests: assertConversationParticipant throws for non-participant
assertConversationAdmin throws for non-admin
direct conversation dedupe path via service
unread math via service
phases.commit: feat(messaging): service layer with participant/admin authorization

phases.name: API routes + slug wiring
tests: POST /conversations {email} unknown user -> friendly 404, no user created
POST /conversations/:id/messages by non-participant -> 403/404
POST /participants by non-admin -> 403
DELETE /participants/:self by member -> 200 (self-leave)
GET /messages?after= returns incremental payload
GET /attachments/:id non-participant 403/404; participant -> bytes + Content-Type
GET /unread returns { count }

phases.name: Front data layer + polling hooks
preconditions: features/messaging/api/router.ts exists and handles all messaging routes
phases.IMPORTANT_NOTE: All implementation files and tests for this phase already exist on disk as UNTRACKED files (not yet committed). Read them BEFORE doing anything. Do NOT rewrite or overwrite them. Your job is: (1) run the tests, (2) fix any failures within scope, (3) run npm run build, (4) stage and commit.
tests: useUnreadMessages fetches on mount and returns count
useUnreadMessages polls every 15 seconds
useUnreadMessages clears interval on unmount
useThread appends only new messages from ?after= incremental fetch
useConversations loading/error/populated states and reload
steps: 1. Read progress.json and verify preconditions hold.
2. Read ALL existing files in allowedFiles before doing anything — they are already written.
3. Run: npm test -- --testPathPattern="features/messaging/__tests__/hooks"

5. Run: npm run build — must pass.
6. Stage all untracked phase-4 files: features/messaging/front/ and features/messaging/__tests__/hooks/

phases.writeBack: Phase 4 complete. Exports: useConversations (features/messaging/front/hooks/useConversations.ts), useThread (features/messaging/front/hooks/useThread.ts), useUnreadMessages (features/messaging/front/hooks/useUnreadMessages.ts — polls GET /api/messaging/unread every 15s), MessagingProvider + useMessagingContext (features/messaging/front/context/MessagingContext.tsx), full API client (features/messaging/front/services/api.ts — listConversations, getConversation, sendMessage, getMessages, markRead, getUnread, createDirectConversation, createGroupConversation, addParticipant, removeParticipant, getAttachmentUrl). Types in features/messaging/types.ts: ConversationSummary, Message, ConversationParticipant, Conversation, ConversationDetail, MessagesPage, UnreadCount, ConversationList.

phases.name: Chat UI + discovery/group modals + attachments
preconditions: features/messaging/front/services/api.ts exports listConversations, getConversation, sendMessage, getMessages, markRead, createDirectConversation, createGroupConversation, addParticipant, removeParticipant, getAttachmentUrl
tests: ConversationList renders loading skeleton
ConversationList renders empty state: 'No conversations yet'
ConversationList renders error state with retry
ConversationList renders populated list of conversations
Selecting a conversation renders ThreadView and fires markRead
Composer send calls sendMessage and appends the message
NewMessageModal household tab lists household members (mocked GET /api/household/members)
NewMessageModal email tab shows 'No account found' on unknown email
NewGroupModal requires title + at least 1 participant before creating
Non-admin member sees no add/remove controls but sees Leave button
steps: 1. Read progress.json; verify preconditions from phase-4 outputs.notes.
2. Check package.json: if @chatscope/chat-ui-kit-react is NOT listed, run: npm install @chatscope/chat-ui-kit-react @chatscope/chat-ui-kit-styles
3. Write ALL failing integration tests first under features/messaging/__tests__/integration/ before writing any component.

4. Attempt a minimal chatscope render in jsdom. If it throws, create features/messaging/__tests__/mocks/chatscope.tsx mocking MessageList, Message, MessageInput, MainContainer, ChatContainer, ConversationList, Conversation, ConversationHeader — then add the moduleNameMapper entry to jest.config.js (follow the Nivo mock precedent already in jest.config.js).

5. Create features/messaging/front/components/ConversationList.tsx — loading/empty/error/populated states; each item shows conversation title (or participant names for direct), unread badge, last message preview; data-testid='conversation-list'; calls setSelectedConversationId on click.

6. Create features/messaging/front/components/ThreadView.tsx — uses useThread(conversationId); wraps chatscope MessageList; loading/error states; calls markRead on mount and on new messages; data-testid='thread-view'.

7. Create features/messaging/front/components/Composer.tsx — wraps chatscope MessageInput; calls sendMessage; handles image attachment picker (client-side reject >1MB or non-image MIME before send); data-testid='composer'.

8. Create features/messaging/front/components/NewMessageModal.tsx — modal (not window.confirm); two tabs: Household (dropdown from GET /api/household/members, filter out current user) and By Email (text input, shows friendly error if email not found); on confirm calls createDirectConversation.
9. Create features/messaging/front/components/NewGroupModal.tsx — modal; title input + multi-select participants; requires title + >=1 participant; on confirm calls createGroupConversation.

10. Create features/messaging/front/pages/MessagingPage.tsx — wraps MessagingProvider; two-pane layout (ConversationList left, ThreadView right); NewMessageModal / NewGroupModal triggered by toolbar buttons; admin sees add/remove participant controls; any member sees Leave with styled confirm (no window.confirm); data-testid='messaging-page'.
11. Create app/(shell)/messages/page.tsx — thin shell: import MessagingPage and render it; export metadata with title 'Messages'.
12. Run: npm test -- --testPathPattern="features/messaging/__tests__/integration" — fix any failures within allowedFiles.
13. Run: npm run build — must pass.
14. Commit: feat(messaging): chat UI, discovery + group modals, attachments
phases.notes: Resolve whether @chatscope kit renders under jsdom; if it crashes add a mock under features/messaging/__tests__/mocks/ (Nivo precedent in jest.config.js).
doneWhen: app/(shell)/messages/page.tsx exists and exports a default page component
phases.writeBack: Phase 5 complete. Components: MessagingPage (features/messaging/front/pages/MessagingPage.tsx), ConversationList, ThreadView, Composer, NewMessageModal, NewGroupModal (all in features/messaging/front/components/). Shell route: app/(shell)/messages/page.tsx. Chatscope mock: record YES or NO — if YES, mock is at features/messaging/__tests__/mocks/chatscope.tsx and jest.config.js moduleNameMapper was updated. Integration tests under features/messaging/__tests__/integration/.
phases.commit: feat(messaging): chat UI, discovery + group modals, attachments

phases.name: Polish + QA
preconditions: npm run build passes on the current branch
npm test passes on the current branch
tests: MessagingPage renders empty state 'No conversations yet — start one' when conversation list is empty
MessagingPage renders error state with retry button when conversation load fails
ThreadView renders empty state when no messages
ThreadView renders error state when thread load fails

steps: 1. Read progress.json; verify preconditions.
2. Write failing tests for empty/error states and mobile single-pane behavior before editing components.
3. Audit ConversationList: ensure loading skeleton, empty state ('No conversations yet — start one'), and error state with retry are all implemented and covered by tests.
4. Audit ThreadView: ensure loading skeleton, empty state (no messages yet), and error state are all implemented and covered by tests.

8. Run: npm run build — must pass.
